response.note: Counts failed payment attempts for NovaMart in the prior Monday-to-Sunday week (2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25), assuming today is Saturday 2026-10-31 and the status value for failures is 'FAILED'.
response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_attempts FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE merchant_name = 'NovaMart' AND status = 'FAILED' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26' LIMIT 50
